item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 32 #NLPRSD
item.description:

The above conditions are being experienced in #Aurora(Dipaculao, Dinalungan, Dilasag, Casiguran, MariaAurora), #Quirino(Nagtipunan, Maddela), #Isabela(Dinapigue, Palanan, Divilacan, IlaganCity, Aurora, Burgos, Gamu, SanManuel, Roxas, Quezon, Quirino, Mallig, Tumauini, DelfinAlbano, Maconacon, Cabagan, SantaMaria, SanPablo, SantoTomas, SanMariano), #Cagayan(Peñablanca, Enrile, TuguegaraoCity, SantoNiño, Amulung, Alcala, Iguig, Solana, Tuao, Piat, Rizal, Baggao, Lasam, Gattaran, Allacapan, LalLo, Camalaniugan, Buguey, SantaTeresita, Aparri, Ballesteros, Pamplona, Abulug), #MountainProvince(Paracelis, Natonin, Barlig, Sadanga, Bontoc, Besao, Sagada), #Kalinga, #Apayao, #IlocosSur(Quirino, Sigay, SantaCruz, Salcedo, GregorioDelPilar, CityOfVigan, Santa, Caoayan, Narvacan, SantaMaria, SanEsteban, Santiago, Banayoyo, Galimuyod, CityOfCandon, SantaLucia, SanEmilio, Burgos, Lidlidda, Nagbukel, Cabugao, SanJuan, Sinait, Magsingal, SantoDomingo, Bantay, SanIldefonso, SanVicente, SantaCatalina), #Abra, #NuevaVizcaya(AlfonsoCastaneda), #IlocosNorte(Dingras, Banna, Marcos, Piddig, Solsona, Carasi, NuevaEra) and #Pangasinan(Bolinao) which may persist within 2 to 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
